name: Window Net
description: SFI 27.1 driver window net mounted inside the cage between the roof rail and door bars, with a spring-loaded top rod and quick-release latch the belted driver can operate.

components.name: Driver window net (SFI 27.1)
components.description: Ribbon or mesh net filling the driver door window opening to keep arms and head inside in a roll-over. SFI 27.1 nets carry a manufacture date tag; common rule (e.g. NASCAR) is 2 years from manufacture.
components.location: Inside the driver window opening, x ≈ 1.30–2.05, y ≈ 0.68–1.20, z ≈ 0.74.

raceOptions.name: SFI 27.1 ribbon or mesh net (e.g. 18 x 24 in)
raceOptions.notes: Choose border/loop style to match rod type.

installNotes: Net must be mounted on the inside of the cage; driver must release it unassisted.
inspection: Check SFI tag date, UV damage, loose stitching.

sources.title: PRP Seats – SFI certified custom window nets guide
Pegasus Auto Racing – window net mounting kit instructions

components.name: Upper (latch-side) net rod
components.description: 3/8 in steel rod through the net top border/loops; one end pins into a welded sleeve/tab on the roof rail or main hoop, the other end is held by the latch.
components.location: Along driver roof rail, x ≈ 1.35–2.10, y ≈ 1.20, z ≈ 0.62.

specs.Rod: 3/8 in round steel rod (upper support, border/loop nets)

hardware.spec: 1/2 in OD x .065 tube sleeve or drilled tab welded to cage

modelRef.features: Rod through the top sleeve with tabs welded to the roof rail

components.name: Lower net mount (rod/strap on door bar)
components.description: Lower edge of the net is captured by a rod in welded tabs on the upper door bar (or bolted strap), so the net is hinged at the bottom and drops down when released.
components.location: Upper driver door bar, x ≈ 1.35–2.05, y ≈ 0.68.

hardware.spec: 1/4-20 UNC button-head bolt + nyloc through welded tab
hardware.notes: Typical 1/4-20 G8 snug value; all net fasteners must be tight and remain tight (NASCAR rule language). Checked 2026-10: 9 ft-lb sits between standard dry 1/4-20 Grade 5 (about 8 ft-lb) and Grade 8 (about 12-14 ft-lb). The window-net makers publish no torque. Upgraded to typical.

installNotes: Weld 3 tabs on the door bar before paint.

components.name: Window net quick-release latch
components.description: Lever-type or seat-belt-style latch at the front top corner that holds the upper rod. Driver pulls the lever/ring to drop the net. Must be operable by the belted driver and by safety crews from outside.
components.location: Front top of window opening on roof rail/A-pillar bar, x ≈ 1.38, y ≈ 1.18, z ≈ 0.62.

raceOptions.name: Lever-action window net latch (spring rod kit)
raceOptions.notes: SFI-approved when used with top and bottom rods (supplier note).

hardware.spec: 1/4-20 UNC bolt + nyloc through welded tab
hardware.notes: Checked 2026-10: 9 ft-lb sits between standard dry 1/4-20 Grade 5 and Grade 8 values. Upgraded to typical.
